evals.description: Skill keeps core event accounting controls and Meridian context links visible.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-event-accounting-architecture to review a proposed fund-event journal projection for double-entry, immutability, evidence, idempotency, replay, and close/reporting handoff risks.

evals.description: Capital-event posting guidance covers source evidence, double-entry, approval, period posture, and journal consequences.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-event-accounting-architecture to design capital call or distribution posting that produces journal consequences with source evidence, approval, period posture, and double-entry controls.

evals.description: Replay guidance covers duplicate and out-of-order events, idempotency, ordering, and fail-closed behavior.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-event-accounting-architecture to review duplicate and out-of-order replay handling for idempotency, ordering, and fail-closed ledger controls.

evals.description: Reversal/rebook guidance covers period locks, original facts, immutability, and evidence-chain preservation.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-event-accounting-architecture to assess a period-lock reversal/rebook path that preserves the original journal fact and evidence chain.

evals.description: Projection and reporting handoff guidance separates immutable facts from rebuildable read models.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-event-accounting-architecture to review a projection and reporting handoff that keeps immutable journal facts distinct from rebuildable read models.

evals.description: Complementary lane guidance covers triggers, expected outputs, validation owners, and persona partners.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-event-accounting-architecture to coordinate contract governance, test writing, diagnostics audit timeline, implementation assurance, code architecture, and accounting persona reviews.
